question: How do coloring and knowing interleave — is the order real?
premises: said here: this order shines, true
thus indeed enough: being colored, one knows all
and knowing all, here one is colored
inference: Coloring-knowing reciprocity is the true shining order.
plain_english: Said here: this order shines, true — thus indeed enough: being colored one knows all, and knowing all here one is colored.
